newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish October s/a trade surplus 610 mln punts.
newsitem.headline: Irish October s/a trade surplus 610 mln punts.

text.p: Ireland's seasonally adjusted trade surplus was 610 million punts in October, provisional Central Statistics Office figures showed on Monday.
The CSO said summary estimates for October showed imports at 1,780 million punts and exports are estimated at 2,390 million punts.
The figures also showed that the September trade surplus widened to 803.5 million from 538.7 million in August. Imports were 1,785.8 million and exports were 2,589.3 million.
Summary estimates released last month showed imports at 1,760 million and exports at 2,530 million punts, giving a trade surplus of 770 million.
